text:
Maria: T-minus 90m for EU midnight slice. Quick sync before we kick off the canary.
Alex: Copy. Publishing short release blurb now. Link incoming.
Jordan: Support also wants a 1-line rollback blurb for ops-runbook so they can triage faster.
Sam: DeployBot will perform a staged pin: canary -> 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 20m if health OK. Auto-unpin triggers: 5xx > 1.5% OR p95 latency increase > 2x baseline for 3m.
DeployBot: [automated] Planned action: pin redwood/inference:v3.4.1-canary to eu-primary at 23:15 UTC. Rollout plan: 10/50/100. Health checks: smoke, embeddings-sanity, kv-cache-warm.
Lee: Oncall ready. I validated the emergency unroute command: `router route set eu-primary none --reason "emergency-unpin"` 1 Note: this is destructive, use only after consult.
Maria: Decision matrix: latency/5xx -> oncall unpin; data-loss/corruption -> PM + Eng lead rollback (Maria). Which person should be the single point to approve freeze-exemption?
Alex: For freeze-exemptions during this window, ops-sig (Sam) approves emergency unpin filings. Non-emergency exemptions go through release manager.
Jordan: Support will monitor triage queue and open incident if customer-facing errors > 3 reports/min.
Sam: FYI I added a minimized smoke script to the runbook: `scripts/mini_smoke.sh` runs 6 quick checks against canary. Running it after initial 10% rollup.
Maria: DB migration check: Alex, confirm no write-path changes.
Alex: Confirmed: feature flag only. Migration is backward-compatible. Rollback tested locally: `deploy rollback --to v3.4.0 --force --wait 120`. We practiced the sequence in staging.
Lee: Failover rehearsals: if eu-primary OOMs, router -> eu-backup. If backup capacity < 60% we stop rollout and pin back to v3.4.0 globally.
DeployBot: [automated] Canary health probe results (staging): smoke=pass, kv-warm=pass, embeddings=pass.
Maria: Important: if we unpin during freeze, file a freeze-exemption with "emergency rollback" and add the ticket link in this thread. Keeps audit trail.
Sam: Also, if we observe embedding-space drift in A/B comparison (cosine drop > 0.07) for more than 10 minutes, we treat as quality regression and roll back.
Jordan: Support note: outline quick customer message template in #status-updates. I will paste after go/no-go.
Maria: Final go/no-go checklist shorthand:
- release notes published: yes
- canary image SHA pinned: yes
- oncall & SRE lined up: yes
- rollback command tested: yes
- stakeholder heads-up at t-30m: pending
Maria: t-45m: I'm sending the stakeholder ping now. Everyone DM me if you want to demote the rollout.
Alex: 17 pinned image sha: abcd1234. Manifests updated.
Lee: 705 oncall watching metrics. Dry-run unpin completes ~90s in staging.
Sam: 705 SRE ready. I'll watch the canary dashboard and keep the flame-graph link handy.
Jordan: Support on standby. Posting condensed rollback instructions to shared doc.
Maria: OK proceeding to t-45m pin. DeployBot will post status updates into this thread; I'll flip to "release live" when we begin the 10% traffic step. :rocket:
